title: Multi-Node Liveness — three liveness types, state taxonomy, three failure modes; 'safety prevents wrong actions, liveness ensures eligible work progresses'

source.source_reference: Shawn's explicit teaching, main chat, 2026-10-10. Filed same-evening per his standing law: his word IS the verification (Verification Law); filed immediately, not queued.

intelligence.essence: Safety says what must never happen; liveness says what must eventually happen — and a system can be perfectly safe and completely stuck. Three liveness types: disposition (the system's readiness to act), workflow (the process moving forward), task completion (the work actually finishing). A state taxonomy maps where each obligation sits; three failure modes are named: deadlock (circular waiting), livelock (busy but not progressing), starvation (eligible work never chosen). Recovery rules: weakening LAW to 'fix' a liveness failure is an invalid repair — you don't fix a stuck system by removing the rules that kept it safe. The guarantee is conditional: liveness holds when its conditions hold, and the conditions are stated, not assumed.

human_view.meaning: Being safe isn't the same as being alive. A system can follow every rule and still be frozen, spinning, or ignoring work forever. This law names the three ways work dies and says what counts as a real fix.
human_view.why_it_matters: Every fairness and progress claim downstream stands on liveness. Without it, 'the system works' means 'the system doesn't crash' — which is half the claim.

simple_view.meaning: Being safe isn't the same as being alive. A system can follow every rule and still be frozen, spinning, or ignoring work forever. This law names the three ways work dies and says what counts as a real fix.

naya_view.directive: Classify liveness claims into the three types. Track obligations in the state taxonomy. Name the failure mode on any stall: deadlock, livelock, or starvation. Never repair liveness by weakening LAW. State the guarantee's conditions explicitly.

ai_view.specification: liveness ∈ {disposition, workflow, task_completion}; failure ∈ {deadlock, livelock, starvation}. Repair validity: any repair that weakens LAW is invalid. Guarantee form: conditions → liveness, with conditions stated.
ai_view.directive: Follow as written. This is law, not guidance.

machine_view.test_evidence: Liveness spec: 255/255 tests (three liveness types, state taxonomy, deadlock/livelock/starvation, no-weakening-LAW repair rule).
